i.norm: PercentCodec only accepts US-ASCII characters (byte values >= 0) in the "always-encode" list. A negative byte value such as -1 is outside the valid US-ASCII range, so the constructor must reject it with an IllegalArgumentException.
(byte) -1 is a negative (non-US-ASCII) value; 'A' is a valid filler to confirm the entire array is validated, not just the first element.
